reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the SQL string q constructed on line 22, which incorporates param obtained from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") on line 14. The user-supplied value is directly concatenated into the SQL statement without sanitization or parameterization. While the query is stored in a request attribute rather than executed immediately in this method, the resulting string retains full attacker control over the SQL syntax, constituting a valid SQL injection vulnerability.
